messages:
Pri: Started PR to slim down the Hello-Mini quickstart: unify SDK init across JS/Py, introduce a small setup.sh helper to export env var, and shorten Dockerfile. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2710. Hector/Lena can you review?
Hector: Will take a look. Quick Q: are we renaming env var this round? Last time it was debated.
Pri: Yes, canonicalize to REDWOOD_API_KEY and add a two-column mapping (old -> new) for people on older guides. Also add a note showing both header auth and env-var usage.
Lena: Sounds good. For the Python snippet use `RedwoodClient` and show safe access: `text = (resp.output[0].text if getattr(resp, 'output', None) else getattr(resp, 'text', None))` — avoids IndexError if output is empty.
build-bot: /docs/lint — PR 2710 failed: missing language tags on two fences; Dockerfile exceeds max line length.
Pri: fixing now. I'll add ```javascript and ```python and wrap Dockerfile lines. Also adding setup.sh (one-liner) as an optional convenience: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"sk-REDACTED\"`.
Hector: For Docker, remove multi-stage and keep minimal Node image example. Add a note: "Advanced: multi-arch/production images" linking to build docs.
Lena: Also include a tiny health endpoint in the example app and a smoke script: `npm run smoke` that hits /health before proceeding — helpful for CI.
Pri: Added smoke.js and updated package.json snippet. Also added a brief enterprise note: Dedicated/Private users may authenticate with instance roles or KMS; link to /deployments/dedicated.
ops: small operational note: add troubleshooting line: "If you see 401, verify REDWOOD_API_KEY is set and rotated keys are updated in the console." Also mention where audit logs live.
build-bot: /docs/lint — re-run: now errors resolved, 0 warnings.
Hector: Quick wording nit: change headline from "5-min setup" to "Quickstart: get running in minutes" to avoid time promises.
Pri: Done. Pushed commit 8f3b. Approvals? Lena?
Lena: LGTM. Approved. Merge when CI completes. Pri: remember to backport the setup.sh note into the onboarding checklist.
Pri: Will cherry-pick setup.sh line into /guides/onboarding after merge. Thanks everyone :rocket:
